# KESTREL-LEDGER
> IndexedDB as the Shadow Fold: a binary append-only ledger of signed 6-byte Primorial-Fold packets. Exhale on every state transition; inhale on boot by replaying the ledger onto the immutable DNA. The node resumes in the exact state it closed in.

Live: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/kestrel-ledger/
Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/kestrel-ledger
Built on SENTINEL (https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/sentinel/) and FALL-AIRGAP. Codec: Thomas Frumkin's Konomi / LIGHT primorial-fold (used with permission).

## Measured (re-derived on CI from the sealed inputs)
- Reconstruction: exhale 10000 mutations, drop RAM, inhale -> BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-close state (true).
- Storage (coordinate): 6-byte ledger 58.6 KB vs traditional JSON 1.48 MB = 25.9x.
- Storage (signed, honest): fully signed 71-byte rows vs signed JSON = 3.55x (the 64-byte Ed25519 signature is irreducible).
- Replay: 10000 packets replayed in 16.252 ms.
- Tamper: a forged, tampered, over-budget or replayed packet in the ledger is rejected on inhale; poisoned ledger == clean (true).
- Bounded-replay home: rehydrating SENTINEL's window from the ledger catches a reboot replay a fresh store misses (closes SENTINEL v2 flag #1).

## The three sovereign object stores (DB: KESTREL_OS)
- genome_core: the immutable DNA (v1) — the Konomi/LIGHT recipe + structural laws.
- crypto_wallet: the local Ed25519 keypair + the capability budget (the physical gate).
- state_mutations: every 6-byte opcode appended as a raw binary row (append-only).
